title: Federation monitor loop lacks a test with a real MAC-signed 409/503 health refusal
outcome: The federation monitor's refusal branches are covered by a deterministic test that drives an actual MAC-signed 409 and 503 health refusal through the monitor loop, with no product behavior change.
acceptance: A deterministic test drives MAC-signed 409 and 503 health refusals through the federation monitor loop and asserts that the lease and diagnostic reason are retained while a local authority loss still fences, with one clean review pair.
